replies.reason: Check `show ip bgp neighbors 192.0.2.0` for evidence about the symptom.
Check `show interfaces counters errors` for evidence about the symptom.
Check `show interfaces Ethernet47` for evidence about the symptom.
Check `show interfaces Ethernet47 transceiver` for evidence about the symptom.
Check `show interfaces Ethernet48 transceiver` for evidence about the symptom.

replies.root_cause: Physical-layer errors on Ethernet47 (CRC/FCS and symbol errors, low Rx power -12.6 dBm) corrupt frames, so BGP keepalives are lost and the 9 s hold timer expires. Fix: clean/replace the fiber or SR optic on Et47 / spine Et3/1; consider BFD and less aggressive BGP timers in the meantime.
